text:
alex: Handoff — I'm on until 23:30 PT then maria takes over. Quick notes: export queue lag trending up (see grafana), dedupe_worker retry errors ~2% last hour, canary rollout showed +2% error rate but appears stable. I pushed a small autoscaler config change (scale down buffer -> 30s) — watch for CPU spikes. Runbooks: https://redwood/runbooks/oncall  Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/exports/export-queue. I'll be reachable on pager for ~15m.

oncall-bot: Alert firing: export_queue_delay > 20m on prod — alert ID a-2432.

ryan: Acked. Looking at consumer side, S3 retries spiking, likely causing backlog. Checking batch failure logs and requeue counts.

alex: If you need a targeted requeue: `./scripts/requeue_failed.sh --service export --limit 500` — only run after sync with me or maria. DO NOT run full reprocess between 00:00-02:00 PT (backup window).

maria: Taking over at 23:30. I'll monitor the queue and hold on requeues until we confirm retry root cause. Thanks for the heads up. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout for model-encoder-v2 completed (3/3 hosts). No failed checks reported.

sophia: FYI — I saw a bump in 5xxs on /generate in canary around 23:10 for ~10m, we rolled that canary back to stable traffic. Might be related to encoder canary, watching metrics.

ryan: Noted. If queue lag doesn't resolve after targeted retries, we should escalate to infra for burst capacity. Drafting a scaling request ticket: https://tickets/INC-789

maria: On it. Updating the handoff doc now. Watchlist for next shift: export queue delay > 30m, dedupe retries > 5%, /generate 5xx > 1% sustained over 5m. Action items: (1) monitor export queue (maria), (2) hold requeue until retry rates confirmed & coord with infra (maria/ryan), (3) escalate scaling if persists (maria).

alex: Thanks team — passing pager to maria. I'll be available for 15m if anything pops up. :eyes:
